marketing_description: The Milwaukee M12 Series Battery Pack includes two 12V Lithium-Ion batteries with a 2 Ah capacity, designed for use with Milwaukee M12 Cordless Power Tools. Equipped with REDLINK Intelligence, these batteries provide optimized performance and overload protection while operating down to 0°F/-18°C. They feature a black and red color and deliver up to 2X more run-time, 20% more power, and 2X more recharges than standard lithium-ion batteries.
